fire: Dear Professor, I have read your discussion of the disputed manuscript with considerable interest.
Before our meeting, I just finished reading the chapter on ancient irrigation systems.
In preparation for Sunday, I have read the passage about forgiveness several times.
Thank you for the recommendation; I just finished reading that remarkable historical novel.
Regarding your objection, I have read the original correspondence and found the dates consistent.
After a long afternoon, I just finished reading your detailed account of the expedition.
For tomorrow's seminar, I have read both translations of the opening dialogue.
As promised in my earlier letter, I just finished reading the revised introduction.
